concerns.text: FR-004 requires generating ≥ 10 000 ΛCDM Gaussian random realizations, but Constitution VI (FR-030) mandates validation against exactly 1 000 realizations. This direct conflict makes the required simulation count ambiguous and violates the higher‑level constitutional rule.

Functional requirements reference user‑story identifiers US-1, US-2, US-3, yet the User Stories are only labeled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, “User Story 3” without explicit US‑1/US‑2/US‑3 IDs. The cross‑references cannot be resolved, breaking traceability.
